questions.stem: 4.8 g of magnesium is burned: 2Mg + O₂ → 2MgO. The theoretical yield of MgO is 8 g, but only 7.2 g is obtained. What is the percentage yield? (Ar: Mg = 24, O = 16)
A reaction has a percentage yield of 80%. If the actual yield was 50 g, what was the theoretical yield?
questions.explanation: Rearranging the formula: theoretical yield = (actual yield / percentage yield) × 100 = (50/80) × 100 = 62.5 g.
